not_compared_reason: Different estimators, not the same number computed twice. statsmodels' MixedLM fixed-effect SEs and lmerTest's agree only when the variance components are sharply determined, which they are not here (17/30 lung and 19/27 brain patients contribute one AOI); statsmodels reaches the same variance components under lbfgs, powell and bfgs, so this is not an optimiser artefact. lmerTest reports Satterthwaite df, statsmodels a Wald z with no finite-sample correction. The SE, CI and p-value of record are lmerTest's; recomputing the CI in statsmodels gives a wider one.
